messages:
Aisha: idea: sampled cohort attribution to reduce ingest cardinality for billing. default = cohort-level aggregates, exact accounting via sample+reconciliation or opt-in full retention.

Tyler: how do cohorts avoid mixing very different cost shapes?

Aisha: key = tenant||model||len_bucket; deterministic hash with epoch prefix. plus cohort-health checks that auto-suggest splits when variance is high.

Maya: customers will ask accuracy. we should show confidence bands in Console and an "exact billing" toggle.

Jin: late enrichment case? tenant missing at edge -> write to anonymous spill cohorts and record enrichment token to reconcile later.

Ben (sre): ops rules: epoched namespace so changing bucket count doesn't remap old cohorts; alert on sudden rise in distinct tenants per cohort. add revert runbook if bleed detected.

Aisha: sample edge snippet: `key=f"{tenant or 'anon'}:{model}:{min(seq,1024)//32}"; cohort=hash(key,seed=epoch)%N; emit(cohort= f"{epoch}-{cohort}")`

Maya: need `expand_cohort(cohort,window,n)` helper to fetch sample traces and stats for audits. will build dashboard for cohort homogeneity.

Tyler: rollout: RFC -> staging spike in 1 region -> measure error bands (median <1.5%, 95th <5%).

Aisha: volunteers: Tyler (ingest), Jin (reconcile), Ben (ops/runbook), Maya (query/QA), Elena (product comms). I'll write RFC with sections: motivation, mapping, epoching, spill/reconciliation, aggregator changes, retention/UX, rollout & rollback, risk matrix.

ingest-bot: deploy scheduled: sampled-cohort branch -> staging 2026-04-16T03:00Z

Elena (product): @Aisha please @me on RFC so we can prep comms.

Aisha: will do. thanks! :rocket:
